notes.title: CAT AWARENESS FELINE SALE 2025
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40007110/9affafd22cbc636ccad8cd37d4491a84dbcd103f.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!

We are delighted to announce that our cat games are part of the [b]Cat Awareness Feline Sale 2025[/b] on Steam, organized by DevCats.

If you love and cherish your feline companions, this is a wonderful chance to support cat-loving creators who care with so much affection.

The event is already live and runs until September 18th. Don’t miss this opportunity to celebrate cats and discover amazing games from different studios!
👉 Check out our featured titles [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59093/CatLogic_Pack/]here[/url].

And remember: all around the world, pets need love, care, and a home. Whenever you can, adopt and protect kittens (or other animals) in need. 💖

We thank [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/devcats]DevCats [/url] for hosting this special event and send all our love and support!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
This small update includes:

 - Control navigation. Now it's possible to navigate through all interfaces using the directional buttons of the Gamepad (controller, joystick).
 - Button remapping. Improved ergonomics when playing with a controller. We kept the keyboard mapping.
 - Inconsistency issues when accessing levels 48, 49, 50.
 - Last game achievement being called.
 - We made the game as cozy and cute as possible.

Thank you for playing Mimi the Cat - New Friends!
Keep posting your comments and suggestions in the Community Hub to help us provide an even better experience.

notes.title: New Controls and Improved Interface
notes.notes:
[i]Mimi the cat - New friends[/i] was the game in which we decided to honor our beloved kitties. Some of these kittens have already become little stars, but each of them accompanied us in unique moments.
We hope you enjoy the updates!
Thank you for playing and supporting us!

We are pleased to announce the following updates:
	
[list]
[*] Full controller compatibility.
[*] Language corrections: German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese.
[*] Optimization in all stages of the game.
[*] Improved interface for a smoother experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44200094/44cbb36ff9b7713256c1c576eb2ee69741e39703.png[/img]
